slides.title: Food truck red flags before holiday market season
slides.body: (and the green flags that fix them)

slides.label: Red flag
slides.title: "The permits are in the glovebox. Somewhere."
slides.body: The market organizer asks for copies. You find a napkin and a 2023 registration.

slides.label: Red flag
slides.title: Nobody knows when the health permit renews.
slides.body: "I think it's the same month as last year?" is not a date.

slides.label: Red flag
slides.title: The new hire's food handler card is "coming."

slides.label: Red flag
slides.title: The event wants a COI by Friday.
slides.body: You're not sure the policy on file is still active.

slides.label: Green flag
slides.title: Every expiration date in one list.
slides.body: Health permit, fire inspection, vehicle registration, commissary agreement, insurance, staff cards.

slides.label: Green flag
slides.title: Renewals start a month early, not the night before.
slides.body: Holiday markets book fast. Your paperwork shouldn't be the hold-up.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Which one is your truck right now?
slides.body: Be honest. Nobody from the health department reads the comments. Probably.
